risk_note: RV2 by path (app.module.ts). POST /v1/inputs/parse used a guest viewer for every request although B1-02m wired identity into catalog: a logged-in user's card was quoted as userId null. parsingPorts now provides identity's ViewerContext globally and the route takes it when injected, so the quoter gets the token's user and level; a viewer that fails or names another app ends only its hit (50001), never a guest. Link ownership did not change: links.user_id already came from linking's CallerContext and input.viewer is ignored (BR-ATTR-05), which is why the rule tests assert the quote's viewer. Identity never comes from the body or headers. The guest fallback for a process without the port is the original line, unchanged; no test reaches it through AppModule any more (S2, followups). No money moves: display quotes only. verify:fast exit 0 (api 3670, spec-tests 20461); [AC-B1-07c#8] and [#9] need a database and run in the required verify-int check. Codex was unavailable until 11-02, so the rule tests and reviews ran on fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36).
